title: DODR: Deterministic Operator-Driven Reasoning in Latent Space

body: Autoregressive (AR) large language models formulate reasoning as token-level probabilistic sampling, which induces three fundamental defects in complex logical reasoning: error accumulation, probability substituting necessity, and the linear-chain information bottleneck. This paper proposes the Deterministic Operator-Driven Reasoning in Latent Space architecture (DODR), which reconstructs reasoning as reasoning-graph computation in a high-dimensional linear-algebraic space. Reasoning states are represented as snapshot vectors whose primitives are semantic units (phrases or sentences) rather than tokens, and each inference step is a deterministic matrix operation with no token sampling. Peirce's three inference types are formalized as three trainable matrix operators: a rank-deficient deduction operator (information collapse), a full-rank induction operator (information expansion), and an abduction operator defined as the Moore-Penrose pseudo-inverse of deduction (information hypothesizing). We prove that the operator set is minimal and complete given Peirce's trichotomy, that no single "super-operator" can realize all three types (a rank obstruction), and that reasoning graphs are Turing-complete with contractive backflow converging by Banach's fixed-point theorem. Experiments on 503 sample records (420 deduplicated samples) across dedicated and end-to-end settings show: deduction loss converges to 1.40e-05; induction achieves 0.9996 generalization coverage with 20/20 hard vetoes on counterexamples; abduction solutions exceed the random baseline by 28x with judgment accuracies of 72.5% (58/80, Wilson 95% CI [61.9%, 81.1%]) and 81.7% (49/60, CI [70.1%, 89.4%]); frozen operators attain 100% (60/60) on unseen cross-domain deduction. The architecture provides a structural zero-hallucination guarantee and a three-layer continual-learning mechanism. All data and code are released.
summaryZh: 本研究提出了一种名为DODR（Deterministic Operator-Driven Reasoning in Latent Space）的架构，旨在解决自回归（AR）大语言模型在复杂逻辑推理中存在的错误累积、概率替代必要性以及线性信息瓶颈等三大缺陷。DODR将推理过程重构为在高维线性代数空间中的推理图计算。推理状态被表示为语义单元（短语或句子）而非token的快照向量，每个推理步骤是确定性的矩阵运算，无需token采样。研究将皮尔士的三种推理类型（演绎、归纳、溯因）形式化为三个可训练的矩阵算子。实验结果表明，DODR在演绎、归纳和溯因任务上均取得了优异性能，且在未见过的跨领域演绎任务上达到了100%的准确率。该架构为大模型提供了结构化的推理机制。

glossary.explanationZh: 指模型在生成序列时，当前生成的元素依赖于之前已生成的所有元素，如GPT系列模型。
模型内部学习到的、通常是低维度的表示空间，捕捉了数据的抽象特征。
一种执行确定性操作的数学算子，意味着对于相同的输入，其输出总是相同的。
一种用图结构表示推理过程的模型，节点代表概念或状态，边代表推理步骤或关系。
哲学家查尔斯·桑德斯·皮尔士提出的三种基本推理形式：演绎（Deduction）、归纳（Induction）和溯因（Abduction）。
